from inspect import getsource

from tabulate import tabulate
from IPython.display import display

import workflow_main as wm
reload(wm)

# ===============================
# UTILITAIRE POUR AFFICHER FONCTIONS
# ===============================

def show_function(func, flag_show = True, flag_run=False, *args):
    if flag_show:
        print("```python")
        print(getsource(func))
        print("```")

    if flag_run:
        print("\n Function print :\n")
        return func(*args)

# ===============================
# CONFIGURATION
# ===============================
data, config_main, config_cluster, config_lc, config_gridsearch, config_scatter, config_plot = wm.build_config()

# Flags
flag_IR = wm.flag_IR
flag_ER = wm.flag_ER

# Fonctions
import_data_IR = wm.import_data_IR
assign_innova_point = wm.assign_innova_point
import_data_ER = wm.import_data_ER

stats_model = wm.stats_model

# Model(s) analysis


```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: true

list_model, models_choosen, param_grid_choosen =wm.list_models, wm.models_choosen, wm.param_grid_choosen
use_grouping = config_main["use_grouping"]

if config_cluster["show"]:
    print(f"\n## Metadata \n")
    print(f"**Features_X:** {', '.join(uncorr_list)}\n")
    print(f"**Len(Features_X):** {len(uncorr_list)}\n")
    print(f"**Config Gridsearch:**{config_gridsearch}\n")

comparison_rows = []
# =================================
# Legend table
# ================================
print(f"\n## Explanation legend tables\n")
print(f"\n**Columns**\n")
print(f"- rank: ranking regarding cross validation test \n")
print(f"- train_cv: mean score train of the CV \n")
print(f"- test_cv: mean score test of the CV \n") 
print(f"- test: score on the testing dataset \n")
print(f"- diff: test-test_cv \n")
print(f"- r_test: test/test_cv \n")
print(f"- r_train: train_cv/test_cv\n")

print("**Colors**: \n ")
print("[Orange] r\\_test < 0.95 (under performance of the test) \n")
print("[Green] r\\_test > 1.05 (over performance of the test) \n") 
print("[Red] r\\_train not in [0.95, 1.05] (gap between train/test) \n")

print(f"\n## Repartition of train and test\n")
wm.X_train_repartiton(data, config_main, config_gridsearch)




for model_name in list_model:
    config_main["model_name"] = model_name
    config_main["model"]      = models_choosen[model_name]
    config_main["param_grid"] = param_grid_choosen[model_name]

    print(f"\n## Model : {model_name}\n")
    if use_grouping:
        # print("colonnes dupliquées:", data["df"].columns[data["df"].columns.duplicated()].tolist())
        iterable = data["df"].groupby(data["feats_grouping"])
        for group, df_sub in iterable:
            data_sub = {**data, "df": df_sub}
            group_str = group if isinstance(group, str) else "_".join(map(str, group))
            data_sub["current_group"] = group_str
            # =================================
            # Gridsearch analysis
            # ================================
            print(f"\n### Gridsearch — Group: {group_str}\n")
            
            n_total = len(df_sub)
            n_test  = int(n_total * config_main["len_test"])
            n_train = n_total - n_test
            print(f"**Len(group)** : {n_total}, **Len(training)** : {n_train}, **Len(test)** : {n_test} \n")

            params_dict, best_params, top1_row, model_fit = wm.gridsearch_analysis(
                data_sub, config_main, config_gridsearch
            )
            config_main["best_param"] = best_params
            
            
            top1_row.insert(0, "Len total", n_total)
            top1_row.insert(0, "Len test", n_test)
            top1_row.insert(0, "Len training", n_train)
            top1_row.insert(0, "group", group_str)   
            top1_row.insert(0, "model", model_name)
            comparison_rows.append(top1_row)
            
            # Hyperparemeters or Coefficients writting
            first_val = next(iter(params_dict.values()))
            if isinstance(first_val, dict):
                    print(f"\n**Hyperparameters:**\n")
            else:
                    print(f"\n**Coefficients:**\n")
            for rank, param in sorted(params_dict.items()):
                if isinstance(param, dict):
                    # CAS 2 gridsearch — dict de params
                    print(f"Rank {rank}: {param}\n")
                else:
                    # CAS 1 linéaire — coefs individuels
                    print(f"  {rank} = {param:.4f}\n")


            # ================================
            # Scatter plot
            # ================================
            if config_scatter["show"]:
                print("\n### Scatter \n")
                wm.scatter_plot(data,config_main,model_fit)

            if config_scatter["show_res"]:
                print(f"\n### Scatter residuals\n")
                wm.scatter_res(data,config_main,model_fit)
                

            # ================================
            # Learning curve
            # ================================
            print(f"\n### Learning curve — Group: {group_str}\n")
            n_train_test = int(n_train*config_main["len_test"])
            n_train_real = n_train - n_train_test 
            print(f"**Len(group)** : {n_total}, **Len(training)** : {n_train}, \n")
            print(f"**Len(training_real)** : {n_train_real}, **Len(test_of_training)** : {n_train_test}, **Len(test)** : {n_test} \n")
            wm.create_learning_curve(data_sub,config_main,config_lc)

    
    else:
        # ================================
        # Gridsearch
        # ================================
        print(f"\n### Gridsearch \n")
        params_dict, best_params, top1_row, model_fit = wm.gridsearch_analysis(
                data, config_main, config_gridsearch
            )
        config_main["best_param"] = best_params

        top1_row.insert(0, "model", model_name)
        comparison_rows.append(top1_row)

        # Hyperparemeters or Coefficients writting
        first_val = next(iter(params_dict.values()))
        if isinstance(first_val, dict):
                print(f"\n**Hyperparameters:**\n")
        else:
                print(f"\n**Coefficients:**\n")
        for rank, param in sorted(params_dict.items()):
            if isinstance(param, dict):
                # CAS 2 gridsearch — dict de params
                print(f"Rank {rank}: {param}\n")
            else:
                # CAS 1 linéaire — coefs individuels
                print(f"  {rank} = {param:.4f},")

        # ================================
        # Scatter plot
        # ================================
        if config_scatter["show"]:
            print("\n### Scatter \n")
            wm.scatter_plot(data,config_main,model_fit)

        if config_scatter["show_res"]:
            print(f"\n### Scatter residuals\n")
            wm.scatter_res(data,config_main,model_fit)

        # ================================
        # Learning curve
        # ================================
        print(f"\n### Learning curve\n")
        n_total = len(data["df"])
        n_test  = int(n_total * config_main["len_test"])
        n_train = n_total - n_test
        n_train_test = int(n_train*config_main["len_test"])
        n_train_real = n_train - n_train_test 
        print(f"**Len(group)** : {n_total}, **Len(training)** : {n_train}, \n")
        print(f"**Len(training_real)** : {n_train_real}, **Len(test_of_training)** : {n_train_test}, **Len(test)** : {n_test} \n")
        wm.create_learning_curve(data,config_main,config_lc)

# ====================
# Sum-up table
# ====================

if config_gridsearch["sumup-table"]:
    print(f"\n## Sumup-table\n")
    wm.create_comparison_table(comparison_rows, use_grouping)

```
